name: Onomiya Yutsuki
source:
Yutsuki is a new heroine included in the PSP game version. She is a second-year student of Yuihime Girls' Academy, but is not in [url=/c5290]Shingo's[/url] class. She is in the drama club. She is good at cooking but not good at cleaning. She lives in a shrine with her parents and grandmother.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mashiroiro_Symphony]Wikipedia[/url]]
